scope: Source evidence audit, four of sixteen hypotheses only; not a second independent model review
source_review: Source webpages accessed separately from existing GPT6 label work; same model reasoning is not an independent reviewer.

records.evidence: Audi IRIS camera verifies correct vehicle technical labels and placement; same article separately reports WSD weld splatter detection.
records.caution: Label verification does not demonstrate crack/scratch training or localization; WSD is a different application, do not attribute it to IRIS.

records.evidence: Brex AI groups expenses, flags policy concerns, gives explanations and recommendations.
records.caution: No access-log, privilege-change or identity anomaly model is documented.

records.evidence: Aggreko monitors real-time equipment IoT data and anticipates failure/maintenance issues.
records.caution: Does not prove prediction of supplier delivery delays; would require distinct target labels and features.

records.evidence: Ontada uses Azure Document Intelligence for PDF text and Azure OpenAI for clinical entity extraction.
records.caution: PII entity categories, precise document span localization and masking not demonstrated.

zero_positive_verification: Existing zero-positive claims only reflect absence of confirmed relevant mechanism among frozen 112; cannot prove absence without independent full-corpus blind re-evaluation.
method_warning: Do not promote provisional grade 2 to independently verified labels based on source authenticity alone.
